headline: Sanctioned Iranian Tanker Delivers LPG Cargo to China
summary: A sanctioned Iranian tanker carrying approximately 500,000 barrels of liquefied petroleum gas bypassed the U.S. naval blockade and delivered its cargo to China, following a transit filmed at a Malaysian anchorage.
why: Sanctions enforcement on Iranian energy exports is a key geopolitical factor influencing global oil and gas supply flows, shipping compliance, and international trade relations.
